_comment: Approval entries for assets that: (a) exceed the 500 KB raster limit, or (b) are loaded by script and not detectable via HTML/CSS scan. Keys are paths relative to dist/.
_unusedOk_comment: Set unusedOk: true for large assets not reachable via HTML/CSS scan (e.g. loaded by Three.js or other JS at runtime).

assets/posters/poster-2-red-giant.webp.reason: Loaded at runtime by PosterSlideshow.tsx (the reduced-motion hero fallback slideshow). Not referenced in static HTML/CSS — the src is constructed dynamically from the POSTERS constant in src/hero/components/reduced-motion/PosterSlideshow.tsx.
